en.headline: Hang Seng closes up 118 points as property and oil stocks lead
en.dek: The index ended Monday at 23,211.81, a 0.51 per cent gain, with mainland banks and oil counters strong while technology and AI hardware shares lagged.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed at 23,211.81 on Monday, up 118.44 points or 0.51 per cent, after trading in a narrow range that saw an early dip of more than 80 points before recovering.

Property and mainland bank shares led the advance, with the property sub-index rising nearly 2.6 per cent. Oil stocks also gained on Middle East tensions, with PetroChina up nearly 6 per cent and Sinopec up about 4 per cent.

Technology and AI-related counters were weaker. The Hang Seng Tech Index fell 0.36 per cent to 3,857.53, with chip and optical communication names under pressure. Main board turnover was about HK$175.8 billion.
Resource and gold-related shares also declined, with some miners falling 5 per cent or more.

zh.headline: 港股高收 118點 地產內銀及三桶油造好
zh.dek: 恒生指數周一收報23211點，升幅0.51%，地產及內銀股領先，科技及人工智能硬件股份則偏弱。
body: 恒生指數周一收市報23211.81點，升118.44點或0.51%。大市初段曾跌逾80點，午後一度倒升最多約166點後回穩。
地產分類指數升近2.6%，內銀股亦上升。中東局勢緊張帶動油股造好，中石油升近6%，中石化升約4%。
科技指數收報3857點，跌0.36%。晶片及人工智能相關股份受壓。主板成交額約1758億元。
資源及黃金相關股份亦偏弱，部分礦業股跌幅達5%或以上。
